tasks.title: Console and deploy docs publish under Coming soon with safe comment handling and verified preview facts
tasks.spec: ## Repository: website — Steps 1–4 and the docs/facts portion of Step 5; Required behavior: Docs, Facts and fixtures, README; Decisions 5, 7–8; Counterexamples: Nav, Comment dropping, Pins; Acceptance evidence 2–5 and the initial Performance impact measurement. Before the first edit, install Bun 1.4.0 dependencies, run the release guards, and capture the build/budget baseline on unmodified main, including Home/Hosted/CSS gzip sizes and the CLI route's absence. A release triggers the needs-input hold described by the spec, naming its tag. Write the specified failing tests first. Add console/deploy after kit in DOC_REPOS and generate only their pins with docs:bump console deploy, recording independent main refs at bump time. Append the exact four-entry Coming soon group and pager expectation; preserve NavEntry, navProblems and DOC_FILE. Add string-based isOnlyComment and drop only one complete comment per HTML token; preserve escaping and URL handling for every other input and exercise all seven listed counterexamples through both the helper and renderMarkdown. Copy both upstream fixtures byte for byte from the new docs pins; add CLI_WIZARD_PROMPTS, CONSOLE_SETUP and their literal/fixture tests. Update README's eight-repo description and all three requested explanatory sentences. If upstream main adds docs, include them once with unique labels and record the addition; a rejected upstream link/anchor requires the specified needs-input hold rather than an edit of fetched docs or weakened checks. Keep the six existing pins unchanged. Preserve the baseline, refs and fixture-comparison results for T2's final PR evidence.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; all six existing repository entries deep-equal main, console has exactly the three specified files and deploy exactly docs/cli.md; only the documented main-gained-docs exception permits a different new-file list

acceptance.command: bun -e 'import {execFileSync} from "node:child_process"; import {readFileSync} from "node:fs"; import assert from "node:assert/strict"; const {repos}=JSON.parse(readFileSync("docs.config.json","utf8")); for(const [key,path,file] of [["deploy","cli/prompt.ts","deploy-cli-prompt.ts.txt"],["console","src/pages.ts","console-pages.ts.txt"]]) { const upstream=execFileSync("curl",["-fsS","https://raw.githubusercontent.com/"+repos[key].repo+"/"+repos[key].sha+"/"+path]); assert.deepEqual(readFileSync("test/fixtures/"+file),upstream,file); }'
acceptance.expected: exit 0; both fixtures are byte-equal to the independently fetched upstream files at their docs.config.json pins

tasks.title: Home and Hosted show the new features, optional console and previews and pass all site gates
tasks.spec: ## Repository: website — remaining content/icon/CSS portion of Step 5, Step 6, all Home and Hosted tests, and final Acceptance evidence 1–9; Required behavior: Home, Architecture, Icons and Hosted; Performance impact and Security impact checklists. Depends on T1's generated docs routes and verified facts. Implement the four exact feature cards in the specified 15-card order, component-first status copy, optional fifth console in SVG/list with dashed outline/admin API arrow and the exact accessible description, all five icon paths, the new InActionPreviews component and responsive token-based styles. Insert the three noninteractive status/CLI/console figures and the two Coming next cards in the exact section order, using T1 facts for preview strings and the exact labels/captions/links. Add the Hosted fifth included card and comparison row with AVAILABILITY/PARITY. Add the full literal content and counterexample assertions prescribed by the section; update old counts to 15 feature cards and 4 text links, plus Hosted bounds to at least 7 rows and 5 cards. Keep #487 content/regressions, hero Terminal/COMPOSE_SERVICES, the single live-preview island, status-mock, existing service copy, plans, waitlist and all 16 placeholder names unchanged. No dates, download links, visitor-facing agent text, new island/runtime dependency, raster preview, inline styles/scripts or external runtime requests. Run the whole-change gates and review all three security checklist areas (input validation, links, secrets in responses). In the final PR body record T1's independent refs/pin integrity/fixture provenance and baseline, before/after gzip measurements (CLI was absent before), all four generated docs routes and a11y coverage, Security impact: yes with checklist evidence, checks/limits and any permitted upstream-doc additions; obtain green check and site CI jobs.
